title: Evaluation after pulling back inputs
statement: Let $T$ be a circuit tail with $m$ inputs, let $g$ be an AND or OR gate, let $e:	ext{Fin}(k)	o	ext{Fin}(m)$ be an injective map, and assign a sign to each of the $k$ inputs. Pulling the circuit inputs back along $e$ and evaluating gives the same sign as evaluating the original tail after assigning the given values on the image of $e$ and assigning $-1$ outside that image for an AND gate, or $1$ outside it for an OR gate.
hypotheses_covered: An injective map from the $k$ input indices to the $m$ input indices
A sign assignment on the $k$ input indices
